newsitem.title: UK: First Chicago to end US bond trade in London.
newsitem.headline: First Chicago to end US bond trade in London.

text.p: First Chicago NBD Corp will close its U.S. Treasuries trading operation in London in the middle of the first quarter of 1997, the chairman of First Chicago Capital Markets told Reuters on Tuesday.
Five positions will be made redundant in the London office and the people concerned have been notified that they are likely to be leaving at the end of January, he said.

"This is part of the consolidation of government bond dealing into a single office, the Chicago office," said Gerry Byrne, chairman of First Chicago Capital Markets. "As far as we are concerned, this will end the consolidation."
First Chicago does not have Treasury trading operations elsewhere in Europe, he said.
